LAW AND MOTION 301, A R G U E D; THE COURT ADOPTED IT'S TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS - DEFENDANT KATHLEEN ANDERSON'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS FOR LACK OF PERSONAL PERSONAL JURISDICTION IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT HAS NO CONTACT WITH THE STATE. PLAINTIFF PRESENTS NO EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT CONSENTED TO THE CAR BEING DRIVEN INTO THE STATE. EVEN IF MINIMUM CONTACT EXISTED IT WOULD BE CONSTITUTIONALLY UNFAIR TO EXERCISE JURISDICTION OVER DEFENDANT SIMPLY BECAUSE SHE NEGLECTED TO OBTAIN THE NAME OR DRIVER'S LICENSE OF THE BUYER OF HER VEHICLE.
